subject: E-Commerce
title: Alibaba and China's E-Commerce Boom
description: One-minute skill: Alibaba and China's E-Commerce Boom.

hook.text: Alibaba's Singles' Day 2023 generated more sales than Black Friday and Cyber Monday combined.

buildup.text: Jack Ma founded Alibaba in 1999 to connect Chinese factories with global buyers. He started in his apartment.

discovery.text: Alibaba built Alipay because Chinese consumers didn't have credit cards. It solved trust from scratch.

twist.text: China leapfrogged credit cards entirely. Mobile payments went straight from cash to QR-code scanning.

climax.text: Chinese e-commerce is now larger than the US, EU, and UK combined. It scaled without credit cards.

punchline.text: No credit cards needed. China built e-commerce on mobile payments from scratch.

quiz.question: How did Chinese e-commerce overcome the lack of credit cards?
